english: I don't like traveling by air.
There was something I needed to get at the supermarket, but I forgot to pick it up.
reference: Na ɛsɛ sɛ metɔ ade/biribi wɔ sotɔɔ no mu nanso mewerefiie

english: I wonder why she is so worried.
reference: Misusuw nea enti a ɔreteetee saa no ho.

english: I am of the opinion that necessity is the mother of invention.
reference: M'adwenkyerɛ ne sɛ ohia ma adwendwen

english: My bag is too old. I must buy a new one.
reference: Mebɔtɔ no akyɛre dodo, ɛsɛ sɛ metɔ foforow

english: Yaw lay awake almost all night thinking about Adwoa.
reference: Yaw dwenee Adwoa ho anadwo no nyinaa a wanna
